notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional interaction TAR and NMR surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies delivery before matching ordinary Time Advance Request and Next Message Request grants, independent recipient frontiers, source-region and retraction metadata, query logical time, callback ordering, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction delivery through Time Advance Request and Next Message Request with FederateAmbassador receive and time-advance-grant callbacks
